name: save-boot-2-bad-checksum
description: #38 acceptance: the same save with its checksum stored inverted (boot checksum "wrong"). The file is listed (slot_mask 1), Circle on it starts loading (mode 4), and the game rejects it: the menu returns to the file list (w_ruined; the game shows "file ruined", decomp src/menu/title.c) and does not fade out. So the checksum matters, and the right card's acceptance in save-boot-1-load confirms the algorithm and its range.
